title: Director of Sales

role_match.role_rationale_from_stage3: This role drives revenue growth in Canon's large-format graphics segment and owns customer relationships with sign manufacturers, vehicle wrap installers, and architectural graphics producers - Tedlar's exact target customers. Their priorities align with Tedlar because: (1) Solution selling - Tedlar provides a value-add recommendation that helps Canon sales teams differentiate against competitors (HP, Epson) by offering customers a complete durability solution, not just hardware; (2) Customer retention and expansion - when Canon's customers succeed with longer-lasting graphics protected by Tedlar, it reduces churn and creates upsell opportunities for more Canon equipment; (3) Premium positioning - Tedlar's extreme durability (12-20+ years) and graffiti resistance enable Canon to target higher-margin premium projects (architectural facades, transit graphics, high-end vehicle wraps) where customers will pay more for total cost of ownership reduction. Given Canon's emphasis on outdoor durability, water-resistant media, and harsh condition applications in their Colorado and Arizona marketing, the sales team needs a protective film partner that delivers on these promises and helps close deals where durability is the deciding factor.

engagement_strategy.scope_and_authority: [Name] leads Canon USA's large-format graphics sales organization, driving revenue across the Colorado M-series, Arizona flatbed, and imagePROGRAF printer lines. They own relationships with sign manufacturers, vehicle wrap installers, and architectural graphics companies—the exact customer base that specifies protective films. Their scope includes competitive positioning against HP and Epson, customer account expansion, and enabling their sales team to close deals in premium durability-focused segments. They likely report to a VP of Sales or SVP of Business Unit and manage regional sales directors or account executives. Their decision authority includes recommending partner solutions, approving sales enablement materials, and shaping go-to-market strategy for Canon's large-format portfolio.
engagement_strategy.relevant_use_cases: For [Name]'s sales organization, Tedlar enables three critical use cases: (1) Vehicle wraps and fleet graphics—Canon's Colorado M-series with UVgel technology produces vibrant vehicle wraps, and Tedlar overlaminate extends graphic life to 12-20+ years while resisting graffiti and weathering, creating a complete Canon + Tedlar solution that wins deals against competitors; (2) Architectural graphics and building facades—Canon's Arizona flatbed printers serve this market, and Tedlar's UV resistance and extreme temperature performance (-70°F to 230°F) protect high-value architectural installations, enabling Canon to compete for premium projects where total cost of ownership matters; (3) Outdoor signage and advertising—Canon emphasizes water-resistant media and outdoor durability, and Tedlar's no-yellowing, no-fading protection ensures Canon customers' graphics maintain color vibrancy for years, reducing warranty claims and strengthening Canon's reputation for quality. Each use case gives [Name]'s team a competitive differentiator and upsell opportunity.
engagement_strategy.personal_stakes: [Name] is measured on revenue growth, win rates against HP and Epson, customer retention rates, and average deal size in the large-format graphics segment. They personally care about solving: (1) Competitive differentiation—in a commoditized printer market, offering a protective film partnership that delivers measurable durability advantages helps Canon sales teams justify premium pricing and win on value, not just specs; (2) Customer success and churn prevention—when Canon customers experience graphic failures (fading, cracking, UV damage) after purchase, it damages relationships and reduces repeat equipment sales; Tedlar's proven performance reduces these issues; (3) Premium market penetration—high-margin projects in architectural graphics, transit interiors, and high-end vehicle wraps demand extreme durability guarantees; Tedlar enables [Name]'s team to credibly compete in these segments where customers will pay more for reduced maintenance and replacement costs. Tedlar directly impacts [Name]'s ability to grow revenue while protecting Canon's quality reputation in the field.
engagement_strategy.timing_factors: Canon served as title sponsor of PRINTING United Expo 2025 in Orlando (October 2025), where they debuted the Colorado XL-series globally and showcased the Arizona flatbed and imagePROGRAF lines. This demonstrates Canon is in active market-expansion mode and investing heavily in large-format graphics visibility. Additionally, Canon recently launched Colorado M-series enhancements (April 2025) emphasizing durability, scratch resistance, and weather resistance for vehicle graphics—exactly where Tedlar adds value. Canon's marketing materials emphasize 3M MCS Warranty certification and outdoor performance, signaling they're positioning against competitors on quality and durability claims. This makes NOW an ideal time to engage [Name]: their sales team is actively selling these durability benefits to customers, and Tedlar provides the protective film solution that delivers on Canon's promises. The timing aligns with their product launch cycle and trade show momentum.

personalization_hooks.hook: Canon's Colorado M-series and Arizona printers emphasize weather resistance and outdoor performance, but Canon currently lacks a recommended protective film partner to complete the durability story for customers
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Position Tedlar as the missing piece in Canon's solution portfolio—frame it as a strategic partnership that helps [Name]'s sales team sell complete durability solutions (Canon printer + Tedlar protection) rather than just hardware, giving them a competitive edge when customers ask 'how do I make sure this graphic lasts 15+ years outdoors?'

personalization_hooks.hook: Canon competes directly with HP and Epson in large-format graphics, and [Name]'s team needs tangible differentiation beyond printer specs to win deals
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Lead with competitive advantage—explain how a Canon + Tedlar partnership creates a defendable market position that HP and Epson can't easily replicate, especially in premium segments (architectural facades, high-end vehicle wraps, transit graphics) where customers prioritize total cost of ownership over initial equipment price

personalization_hooks.hook: [Name]'s customers—sign manufacturers, vehicle wrap installers, architectural graphics producers—face direct pain from graphic failures, warranty claims, and premature replacements that hurt their own businesses and reflect poorly on Canon equipment
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Frame Tedlar as a customer success enabler for [Name]'s accounts—when Canon customers use Tedlar-protected graphics, they experience fewer failures, lower maintenance costs, and longer graphic lifespans, which strengthens their loyalty to Canon equipment and creates upsell opportunities for [Name]'s team; this is about protecting Canon's installed base and growing wallet share

recommended_approach: Lead with competitive differentiation and solution-selling angle. [Name] is revenue-focused and needs to understand how Tedlar helps their sales team win deals and grow accounts. Open by acknowledging Canon's strong positioning in outdoor durability (Colorado UVgel, Arizona quality focus) and position Tedlar as the strategic partner that completes their story—helping Canon sales teams sell outcomes (12-20 year graphic performance) not just equipment. Frame the conversation around enabling [Name]'s team to compete in premium segments and protect Canon's quality reputation in the field. Offer to discuss how other equipment manufacturers have leveraged protective film partnerships to drive sales differentiation, then propose a brief call to explore fit for Canon's large-format portfolio.
